transcript: Good morning. Please sit down. What brings you in today? Good morning, doctor. I have been having a fever and a bad cough for the last 3 days. Any headache or body pain along with that? Yes. I have a headache mostly in the evening, and I vomited once yesterday. Are you taking any medication currently? I took paracetamol twice, but the fever came back. Do you have any known allergies? No allergies, doctor. Any history of diabetes or high blood pressure? My blood pressure was slightly high last year, but I'm not on any tablets. Let me check. Your temperature is 101 degrees. Is it serious, doctor? It looks like a viral infection. I will start you on paracetamol 500 milligrams, twice a day after food for 5 days. Should I take anything for the cough? Yes. Take cetirizine 10 milligrams at night. Drink plenty of fluids and come back in 1 week if the fever does not settle. Thank you, doctor.
